beats.headline: A brother in a trash-filled berth
beats.text: For the record: Minus is a soother and a soldier of Syndicate security, and the file opens on him standing over his brother Linus's corpse, in a trash-filled berth on one of the swanky habitats orbiting the star, just killed by Syndicate security. The brothers last spoke five cycles ago, a month after their father's funeral. Minus had not known Linus moved off the surface. Posters of Elle cover the walls. He feels guilt, then shame, then the thought that their mother is going to be so pissed.

beats.headline: Orders: act the pervert
beats.text: Captain Fresh hands him a datapad: some five hundred hours of the fairy crawler's footage and every post his brother made about her, to rapid-inject tonight, because the tenth floor begins in hours. He is to be half-corporeal, a non-combatant, attached to the fairy crawler, with a primary and a secondary target. So act the pervert for some time, the captain says. He calls it a suicide mission: a surgical crawler kill to destabilise the group and start the Ascendency game early. Minus salutes. Whatever it takes, sir.

beats.headline: Between Louis and the fleshmancer
beats.text: At the Lollipop, the tourist on file as Linus sits on one side of Grigori the Placid, with Louis on the other scattering cookie crumbs. He stares at Elle with puppy dog eyes. His shirt has moved on from a naked picture of her to a moving, all-over print of her screaming face mid-spell, captioned: Right in the keister! The fleshmancer sits ramrod straight between them, flicking crumbs off his robes, and looks absolutely out of place.

beats.headline: His fingers in Donut's tail
beats.text: While Donut has the fleshmancer brush her, the tourist pats her chain mail crupper and then runs his long fingers along her tail. I'm touching her, he announces. Elle threatens to have someone in the outside world break his creepy little fingers. He carries on regardless: she smells good, Elle doesn't let him sniff her. He whispers something to Donut and sucks his triple-segmented finger. Donut turns: excuse me? Elle gives up and takes him with her. Oh goody, he says. The orders said act the pervert.

beats.headline: Pestering Bautista about tea
beats.text: In the guildhall he is across the room, whispering at Bautista, who is not amused. Per Princess Donut, he keeps trying to get Daniel to make tea: Bautista tea is trending, Daniel has no outreach manager, and the members of her message board are all jealous. Of the tourist, she clarifies, not of Daniel. Elle's Snow Cones fan club raided her server the other day; now the two boards are friends and working together. The tea is noted.

beats.headline: A cup kept ready for two
beats.text: In the entrance square of Hungry Eyes Village, where crawlers bound for the Pineapple Cabaret are saying their goodbyes, Bautista has set out his teapots, and the subject pours: for a chainsaw crawler named Karac, for Prepotente, who demands the recipe blow by blow. Imani and Louis, he says, like it really hot, so he has one ready for them. Elle asks whether he has poisoned their tea out of jealousy. He gives a nervous laugh. Bautista pours for his friends himself.

beats.headline: Outed at his own farewell
beats.text: Elle's speech turns to him. The Snow Cones knew an impostor the moment he arrived, and she reads out an essay the real Linus posted before this floor: he misses his family, especially his big brother. Did he really write that, the soother asks. He never wrote me. He was brought in after his brother was already dead, he says. Donut tells him half the alien internet worked it out five minutes after he arrived. He never really watched the show, he admits. Elle: the poison he pretended to drop in the tea would not have worked anyway. Every drinker was immune.

beats.headline: Imani first, pork chop second
beats.text: Asked for his target, he laughs. Not Carl: the last person they want taken out, the best chance anyone has, because he is the one most likely to get everyone killed. Not the cat: losing her would make Carl too volatile. The target was Imani. The secondary, thumbed over his shoulder, was pork chop, meaning Louis. I was just following orders, he says. Carl's grip pops through the illusion of his neck. It does not hurt him. He is told everyone who put the crawlers here has already lost.

beats.headline: Back to a small ship
beats.text: The subject does not answer. He knows what comes next: out of the dungeon and back to his small, defenseless spaceship, currently trapped in orbit over Earth, where a few friends of the crawlers are waiting for him. The file records that he knew it, and that he said nothing. Elle, wiping her eyes, says her Barry really did love that song.

beats.headline: Named to the whole dungeon
beats.text: The AI, explaining why it changed this race at the last minute, briefs the out-of-the-loop crawlers: the tourist Linus was replaced by his brother, Minus, a soldier, sent to kill two crawlers in hopes their deaths would destabilise the rest. His targets were Imani C and Louis Santiago 2. That surprised it, the AI admits; it does not understand why not Florin, or why not Princess Donut. Donut's first question is only about the name. His name was Minus?
